<script setup lang="ts" generic="TData extends RowData">
import { computed } from 'vue';

import {
    getBooleanFilterOptions,
    getFacetedFilterOptions,
} from '@/lib/data-table-filter-options';
import { getMessage } from '@/lib/data-table-messages';
import type { RowData } from '@/lib/data-table-tanstack';

import {
    type DataTableFilterPieceProps,
    useDataTableFilterColumn,
} from './context';
import DataTableFacetedFilterContent from './DataTableFacetedFilterContent.vue';

/**
 * Yes / No filter of a `boolean` column (`->filterSelect()` in PHP).
 */
const props = withDefaults(
    defineProps<
        DataTableFilterPieceProps<TData> & {
            /** Texts of `true` and `false`; those of `->labels()` by default. */
            labels?: { true: string; false: string };
            /** Shows the number of rows of each option. */
            counts?: boolean;
            /** Shows the search box of the list. */
            searchable?: boolean;
        }
    >(),
    { counts: true, searchable: true, icon: undefined },
);

const column = useDataTableFilterColumn(
    'DataTableBooleanFilter',
    props.column,
    props.table,
);

const options = computed(() =>
    column
        ? getFacetedFilterOptions(
              getBooleanFilterOptions(
                  column.columnDef.meta,
                  {
                      yes: getMessage(column.table, 'yes'),
                      no: getMessage(column.table, 'no'),
                  },
                  props.labels,
              ),
          )
        : [],
);
</script>

<template>
    <DataTableFacetedFilterContent
        v-if="column"
        :column="column"
        :options="options"
        :title="title"
        :counts="counts"
        :searchable="searchable"
        :icon="icon"
        :class="props.class"
        :content-class="contentClass"
        :align="align"
        :disabled="disabled"
    />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';

import { type DataTableCellProps, getCellSetup } from './cells';
import DataTableBooleanCell from './DataTableBooleanCell.vue';
import DataTableDateCell from './DataTableDateCell.vue';
import DataTableNumberCell from './DataTableNumberCell.vue';
import DataTableOptionCell from './DataTableOptionCell.vue';
import DataTableTextCell from './DataTableTextCell.vue';

/**
 * Default cell: picks the cell of the column type, from the `display` declared
 * in PHP or in the page `meta` (a text cell without it). Every type cell is
 * exported to reuse its formatting inside a custom `cell`.
 */
const props = defineProps<DataTableCellProps>();

const type = computed(() => getCellSetup(props.cell).meta?.display?.type);
</script>

<template>
    <DataTableNumberCell v-if="type === 'number'" :cell="cell" />
    <DataTableDateCell v-else-if="type === 'date'" :cell="cell" />
    <DataTableBooleanCell v-else-if="type === 'boolean'" :cell="cell" />
    <DataTableOptionCell v-else-if="type === 'option'" :cell="cell" />
    <DataTableTextCell v-else :cell="cell" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';

import { formatDateValue, isDateOnly } from '@/lib/data-table-format';

import { type DataTableCellProps, getCellSetup } from './cells';
import DataTableEmptyCell from './DataTableEmptyCell.vue';

/**
 * Date with the preset or Intl options of `->format()`; relative dates
 * keep the full date in the tooltip.
 */
const props = defineProps<DataTableCellProps>();

const view = computed(() => {
    const { meta, locale, context } = getCellSetup(props.cell);
    const value = props.cell.getValue();
    const format =
        (meta?.display?.type === 'date' ? meta.display.format : undefined) ??
        context.dateFormat ??
        'long';

    return {
        text: formatDateValue(value, format, locale),
        dateTime: typeof value === 'string' ? value : undefined,
        title:
            format === 'relative'
                ? formatDateValue(
                      value,
                      isDateOnly(value) ? 'long' : 'datetime',
                      locale,
                  )
                : undefined,
    };
});
</script>

<template>
    <!-- With SSR the server formats the date in its time zone and the browser
    in the viewer's: the browser's text wins without a hydration error. -->
    <DataTableEmptyCell v-if="view.text === ''" :cell="cell" />
    <time
        v-else
        :datetime="view.dateTime"
        :title="view.title"
        data-allow-mismatch="text,attribute"
        >{{ view.text }}</time
    >
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { DataTableAnyColumn } from './cells';
import DataTableColumnHeader from './DataTableColumnHeader.vue';

/**
 * Header of a column the component does not customize: the label declared by
 * the table class, with sorting and hiding when the column allows them. The
 * other keys of the header context are accepted too, so they never end up as
 * attributes.
 */
defineProps<{
    column: DataTableAnyColumn;
    header?: unknown;
    table?: unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
    <DataTableColumnHeader
        :column="column"
        :label="column.columnDef.meta?.label ?? column.id"
    />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts" generic="TData extends RowData">
import { computed } from 'vue';

import {
    getBooleanFilterOptions,
    getFacetedFilterOptions,
} from '@/lib/data-table-filter-options';
import { getMessage } from '@/lib/data-table-messages';
import type { RowData } from '@/lib/data-table-tanstack';
import type { ColumnSelectOption } from '@/lib/data-table-types';

import {
    type DataTableFilterPieceProps,
    useDataTableFilterColumn,
} from './context';
import DataTableFacetedFilterContent from './DataTableFacetedFilterContent.vue';

/**
 * List filter for `select`, `multi-select` and `boolean` columns: one popover
 * with the options of the server and their counts.
 */
const props = withDefaults(
    defineProps<
        Omit<DataTableFilterPieceProps<TData>, 'column'> & {
            /**
             * Id of a `select`, `multi-select` or `boolean` column of the PHP
             * class. Without it, the filter only shows `options` (no table
             * needed).
             */
            column?: DataTableFilterPieceProps<TData>['column'];
            /**
             * Relabels, reorders or leaves out the server options (matched by
             * `value`); values the server did not declare are ignored.
             */
            options?: ColumnSelectOption[];
            /** Several values at once; by default, when the column is `multi-select`. */
            multiple?: boolean;
            /** Shows the number of rows of each option. */
            counts?: boolean;
            /** Shows the search box of the list. */
            searchable?: boolean;
        }
    >(),
    {
        column: undefined,
        options: undefined,
        multiple: undefined,
        counts: true,
        searchable: true,
        icon: undefined,
    },
);

const column =
    props.column === undefined
        ? undefined
        : useDataTableFilterColumn(
              'DataTableFacetedFilter',
              props.column,
              props.table,
          );

const options = computed(() => {
    if (!column) return props.options ?? [];

    const meta = column.columnDef.meta;
    const serverOptions =
        meta?.filterVariant === 'boolean'
            ? getBooleanFilterOptions(meta, {
                  yes: getMessage(column.table, 'yes'),
                  no: getMessage(column.table, 'no'),
              })
            : (meta?.options ?? []);

    return getFacetedFilterOptions(serverOptions, props.options);
});
</script>

<template>
    <DataTableFacetedFilterContent
        v-if="column || props.column === undefined"
        :column="column"
        :options="options"
        :title="title"
        :multiple="
            multiple ?? column?.columnDef.meta?.filterVariant === 'multi-select'
        "
        :counts="counts"
        :searchable="searchable"
        :icon="icon"
        :class="props.class"
        :content-class="contentClass"
        :align="align"
        :disabled="disabled"
    />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts" generic="TData extends RowData">
import { computed } from 'vue';

import type { RowData } from '@/lib/data-table-tanstack';

import { type DataTableInstance, useDataTable } from './context';
import DataTableToolbarFilter from './DataTableToolbarFilter.vue';

/**
 * The filter of a single column, with the component of its type. To pass
 * props to it, use that component (`DataTableFacetedFilter`…) instead.
 */
const props = defineProps<{
    /** Not needed inside a provider. */
    table?: DataTableInstance<TData>;
    /** Id of the column in the table class. */
    column: string;
}>();

const table = useDataTable(props.table, 'DataTableFilter');

const found = computed(() =>
    table
        .getAllColumns()
        .find((item) => item.id === props.column && item.getCanFilter()),
);
</script>

<template>
    <DataTableToolbarFilter v-if="found" :column="found" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts" generic="TData extends RowData">
import { computed, type HTMLAttributes, useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import {
    InputGroup,
    InputGroupAddon,
    InputGroupInput,
    InputGroupText,
} from '@/components/ui/input-group';
import {
    type DataTableFeatures,
    getHiddenFilterCount,
} from '@/lib/data-table-features';
import type { FilterAffix } from '@/lib/data-table-format';
import type { Column, RowData } from '@/lib/data-table-tanstack';

import DataTableHiddenFilters from './DataTableHiddenFilters.vue';

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

/**
 * Input of `DataTableTextFilter` and `DataTableNumberFilter`, with the unit
 * or currency next to the value; other attributes go to the input.
 */
const props = withDefaults(
    defineProps<{
        column: Column<DataTableFeatures, TData>;
        type?: 'text' | 'number';
        /** Unit or currency next to the value (`getFilterAffixes`). */
        affixes?: FilterAffix[];
        class?: HTMLAttributes['class'];
    }>(),
    { type: 'text', affixes: () => [] },
);

const attrs = useAttrs();

const value = computed(() => {
    const filterValue = props.column.getFilterValue();

    if (typeof filterValue === 'string' || typeof filterValue === 'number') {
        return String(filterValue);
    }

    return Array.isArray(filterValue) ? filterValue.join(',') : '';
});

// Filters of the column the toolbar can not show (`+N`).
const hiddenCount = computed(() => getHiddenFilterCount(props.column));

function onInput(next: string | number) {
    props.column.setFilterValue(next === '' ? undefined : String(next));
}
</script>

<template>
    <Input
        v-if="affixes.length === 0 && hiddenCount === 0"
        v-bind="attrs"
        :type="type"
        :model-value="value"
        :class="props.class"
        @update:model-value="onInput"
    />
    <InputGroup v-else :class="props.class">
        <InputGroupInput
            v-bind="attrs"
            :type="type"
            :model-value="value"
            @update:model-value="onInput"
        />
        <InputGroupAddon
            v-for="affix in affixes"
            :key="affix.align"
            :align="affix.align"
        >
            <InputGroupText>{{ affix.text }}</InputGroupText>
        </InputGroupAddon>
        <InputGroupAddon v-if="hiddenCount > 0" align="inline-end">
            <DataTableHiddenFilters
                :table="column.table"
                :label="column.columnDef.meta?.label ?? column.id"
                :count="hiddenCount"
            />
        </InputGroupAddon>
    </InputGroup>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts" generic="TData extends RowData">
import { computed } from 'vue';

import type { RowData } from '@/lib/data-table-tanstack';

import { type DataTableInstance, useDataTable } from './context';
import DataTableToolbarFilter from './DataTableToolbarFilter.vue';

/**
 * One control per filterable column, in the table order or in the order of
 * `columns`. No wrapper: they are laid out inside the parent container.
 */
const props = defineProps<{
    /** Not needed inside a provider. */
    table?: DataTableInstance<TData>;
    /** Ids of the columns to show, in this order; all of them by default. */
    columns?: string[];
}>();

const table = useDataTable(props.table, 'DataTableFilters');

const shown = computed(() => {
    const filterable = table
        .getAllColumns()
        .filter((column) => column.getCanFilter());

    return props.columns
        ? props.columns.flatMap((id) =>
              filterable.filter((column) => column.id === id),
          )
        : filterable;
});
</script>

<template>
    <DataTableToolbarFilter
        v-for="column in shown"
        :key="column.id"
        :column="column"
    />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';

import { formatNumberCell, isEmptyValue } from '@/lib/data-table-format';

import { type DataTableCellProps, getCellSetup } from './cells';
import DataTableEmptyCell from './DataTableEmptyCell.vue';

/**
 * Number, currency or percentage with Intl and the table locale; the column is
 * aligned to the end with its header (`meta.align` changes it). The currency
 * code (`cell: 'code'`) and the unit go after the number, smaller and muted.
 */
const props = defineProps<DataTableCellProps>();

const parts = computed(() => {
    const value = props.cell.getValue();

    if (isEmptyValue(value)) {
        return null;
    }

    const { meta, locale } = getCellSetup(props.cell);

    return formatNumberCell(
        meta?.display?.type === 'number'
            ? meta
            : { ...meta, display: { type: 'number' } },
        value,
        locale,
    );
});
</script>

<template>
    <DataTableEmptyCell v-if="parts === null" :cell="cell" />
    <span v-else data-slot="data-table-number" class="tabular-nums"
        >{{ parts.text
        }}<template v-if="parts.suffix"
            >{{ ' '
            }}<span
                data-slot="data-table-number-suffix"
                class="text-xs text-muted-foreground"
                >{{ parts.suffix }}</span
            ></template
        ></span
    >
</template>

<script setup lang="ts" generic="TData extends RowData">
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';

import { getFilterAffixes } from '@/lib/data-table-format';
import type { RowData } from '@/lib/data-table-tanstack';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

import {
    type DataTableColumnRef,
    type DataTableInstance,
    useDataTableFilterColumn,
} from './context';
import DataTableFilterInput from './DataTableFilterInput.vue';

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

/**
 * Exact value filter of a number column with `->filterInput()`, with the unit
 * or currency of the column next to it; other attributes go to the input.
 */
const props = defineProps<{
    /** Not needed inside a provider or with a column object. */
    table?: DataTableInstance<TData>;
    /** Id of the column in the PHP table class (or the TanStack column). */
    column: DataTableColumnRef<TData>;
    class?: HTMLAttributes['class'];
}>();

const column = useDataTableFilterColumn(
    'DataTableNumberFilter',
    props.column,
    props.table,
);
</script>

<template>
    <!-- `numeric` gives a keypad without a decimal separator on iOS. -->
    <DataTableFilterInput
        v-if="column"
        :column="column"
        type="number"
        inputmode="decimal"
        :affixes="getFilterAffixes(column.columnDef.meta)"
        :placeholder="
            column.columnDef.meta?.placeholder ?? column.columnDef.meta?.label
        "
        :aria-label="column.columnDef.meta?.label ?? column.id"
        v-bind="$attrs"
        :class="cn('w-30', props.class)"
    />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { toText } from '@/lib/data-table-format';
import type { ColumnSelectOption } from '@/lib/data-table-types';

import type { DataTableBadgeVariant } from './cells';

/**
 * The project's shadcn Badge with the icon and label of an option: the badge
 * of `->badge()`, exported to reuse it in a custom `cell` with any Badge prop
 * (`variant`, `class`) and its own content in the default slot.
 */
defineProps<{
    /** Option of `meta.options`: its icon and label are shown. */
    option?: ColumnSelectOption;
    /** Raw value, shown when there is no option. */
    value?: unknown;
    variant?: DataTableBadgeVariant;
}>();
</script>

<template>
    <Badge :variant="variant">
        <component :is="option.icon" v-if="option?.icon" aria-hidden="true" />
        <slot>{{ option?.label ?? toText(value) }}</slot>
    </Badge>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts" generic="TData extends RowData">
import type { RowData } from '@/lib/data-table-tanstack';

import { type DataTableInstance, provideDataTable } from './context';

const props = defineProps<{
    table: DataTableInstance<TData>;
}>();

provideDataTable(props.table);
</script>

<template>
    <slot />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts" generic="TData extends RowData">
import { X } from '@lucide/vue';
import { computed } from 'vue';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { getMessage } from '@/lib/data-table-messages';
import type { DataTableIcon, RowData } from '@/lib/data-table-tanstack';

import { type DataTableInstance, useDataTable } from './context';

/**
 * Clears the filters and the search; only shown while one of them is active.
 * With content in the default slot, it is also its accessible name.
 */
const props = withDefaults(
    defineProps<{
        /** Not needed inside a provider. */
        table?: DataTableInstance<TData>;
        /** Icon before the text; `null` hides it. */
        icon?: DataTableIcon | null;
    }>(),
    { icon: undefined },
);

const slots = defineSlots<{ default?: () => unknown }>();

const table = useDataTable(props.table, 'DataTableResetButton');
const isFiltered = computed(
    () =>
        table.atoms.columnFilters.get().length > 0 ||
        Boolean(table.atoms.globalFilter.get()),
);

function onReset() {
    table.resetColumnFilters(true);
    table.resetGlobalFilter(true);
}
</script>

<template>
    <Button
        v-if="isFiltered"
        :aria-label="
            slots.default ? undefined : getMessage(table, 'reset_filters')
        "
        variant="outline"
        @click="onReset"
    >
        <component :is="icon ?? X" v-if="icon !== null" />
        <slot>{{ getMessage(table, 'reset') }}</slot>
    </Button>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts" generic="TData extends RowData">
import { computed, type HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';

import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { getMessage } from '@/lib/data-table-messages';
import type { RowData } from '@/lib/data-table-tanstack';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

import { type DataTableInstance, useDataTable } from './context';

/**
 * Global search (`?search=`). Hidden when the table class declares no
 * `searchable()` column, unless forced with `searchable`.
 */
const props = withDefaults(
    defineProps<{
        /** Not needed inside a provider. */
        table?: DataTableInstance<TData>;
        /** Shows the global search; by default, when the server allows it. */
        searchable?: boolean;
        placeholder?: string;
        class?: HTMLAttributes['class'];
    }>(),
    { searchable: undefined },
);

const table = useDataTable(props.table, 'DataTableSearch');
const shown = computed(
    () => props.searchable ?? table.options.meta?.searchable ?? false,
);
const placeholder = computed(
    () => props.placeholder ?? getMessage(table, 'search'),
);
const value = computed(() => {
    const globalFilter = table.atoms.globalFilter.get();

    return typeof globalFilter === 'string' ? globalFilter : '';
});

function onInput(next: string | number) {
    table.setGlobalFilter(String(next));
}
</script>

<template>
    <Input
        v-if="shown"
        type="search"
        :aria-label="placeholder"
        :placeholder="placeholder"
        :class="cn('w-40', props.class)"
        :model-value="value"
        @update:model-value="onInput"
    />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts" generic="TData extends RowData">
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';

import type { RowData } from '@/lib/data-table-tanstack';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

import {
    type DataTableColumnRef,
    type DataTableInstance,
    useDataTableFilterColumn,
} from './context';
import DataTableFilterInput from './DataTableFilterInput.vue';

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

/**
 * Text filter of a column with `->filterInput()` (contains, without case);
 * other attributes go to the input.
 */
const props = defineProps<{
    /** Not needed inside a provider or with a column object. */
    table?: DataTableInstance<TData>;
    /** Id of the column in the PHP table class (or the TanStack column). */
    column: DataTableColumnRef<TData>;
    class?: HTMLAttributes['class'];
}>();

const column = useDataTableFilterColumn(
    'DataTableTextFilter',
    props.column,
    props.table,
);
</script>

<template>
    <DataTableFilterInput
        v-if="column"
        :column="column"
        :placeholder="
            column.columnDef.meta?.placeholder ?? column.columnDef.meta?.label
        "
        :aria-label="column.columnDef.meta?.label ?? column.id"
        v-bind="$attrs"
        :class="cn('w-40', props.class)"
    />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts" generic="TData extends RowData">
import type { DataTableFeatures } from '@/lib/data-table-features';
import type { Column, RowData } from '@/lib/data-table-tanstack';

import DataTableBooleanFilter from './DataTableBooleanFilter.vue';
import DataTableDateFilter from './DataTableDateFilter.vue';
import DataTableFacetedFilter from './DataTableFacetedFilter.vue';
import DataTableNumberFilter from './DataTableNumberFilter.vue';
import DataTableSliderFilter from './DataTableSliderFilter.vue';
import DataTableTextFilter from './DataTableTextFilter.vue';

/**
 * Filter of a column with the component of its server variant.
 */
defineProps<{
    column: Column<DataTableFeatures, TData>;
}>();
</script>

<template>
    <DataTableTextFilter
        v-if="column.columnDef.meta?.filterVariant === 'text'"
        :column="column"
        class="lg:w-56"
    />
    <DataTableNumberFilter
        v-else-if="column.columnDef.meta?.filterVariant === 'number'"
        :column="column"
    />
    <DataTableSliderFilter
        v-else-if="column.columnDef.meta?.filterVariant === 'range'"
        :column="column"
    />
    <DataTableDateFilter
        v-else-if="
            column.columnDef.meta?.filterVariant === 'date' ||
            column.columnDef.meta?.filterVariant === 'date-range'
        "
        :column="column"
    />
    <DataTableBooleanFilter
        v-else-if="column.columnDef.meta?.filterVariant === 'boolean'"
        :column="column"
    />
    <DataTableFacetedFilter
        v-else-if="
            column.columnDef.meta?.filterVariant === 'select' ||
            column.columnDef.meta?.filterVariant === 'multi-select'
        "
        :column="column"
    />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
// Copyright (c) 2024 Sadman Sakib. SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

import { useVModel } from '@vueuse/core';
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';

import { Popover } from '@/components/ui/popover';

import {
    createVisibility,
    type FacetedOption,
    type FacetedValue,
    provideFaceted,
} from './context';

/**
 * A popover with a searchable list of options, single or multiple: the
 * filters of select columns and the column menu of the data table.
 */
const props = withDefaults(
    defineProps<{
        modelValue?: FacetedValue;
        /** Options, for the labels of the selected values and the search. */
        items?: FacetedOption[];
        multiple?: boolean;
        open?: boolean;
        defaultOpen?: boolean;
    }>(),
    {
        modelValue: undefined,
        items: () => [],
        multiple: false,
        open: undefined,
        defaultOpen: false,
    },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
    'update:modelValue': [value: FacetedValue];
    'update:open': [open: boolean];
}>();

const value = useVModel(props, 'modelValue', emit, { passive: true });
const open = useVModel(props, 'open', emit, {
    passive: true,
    defaultValue: props.defaultOpen,
});
const search = ref('');
const items = computed(() => props.items);
const multiple = computed(() => props.multiple);

// A new search each time the list opens.
watch(open, (isOpen) => {
    if (!isOpen) search.value = '';
});

function setOpen(next: boolean) {
    open.value = next;
}

function selectItem(selected: string) {
    if (props.multiple) {
        const values = Array.isArray(value.value) ? value.value : [];

        value.value = values.includes(selected)
            ? values.filter((item) => item !== selected)
            : [...values, selected];
        return;
    }

    value.value = value.value === selected ? undefined : selected;
    setOpen(false);
}

function clear() {
    value.value = props.multiple ? [] : undefined;
}

function matches(itemValue: string, label?: string) {
    const term = search.value.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();

    if (term === '') return true;

    const text =
        props.items.find((item) => item.value === itemValue)?.label ??
        label ??
        itemValue;

    return text.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(term);
}

provideFaceted({
    value,
    items,
    multiple,
    search,
    selectItem,
    clear,
    setOpen,
    matches,
    ...createVisibility(computed),
});
</script>

<template>
    <Popover v-model:open="open">
        <slot />
    </Popover>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';

import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';

import FacetedSeparator from './FacetedSeparator.vue';

/** Item that clears the selection; only shown while there is one. */
const props = defineProps<{ class?: HTMLAttributes['class'] }>();

                        props.class,

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ListboxItem } from 'reka-ui';
import { computed, type HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

import {
    getIsValueSelected,
    provideFacetedItemSelected,
    registerFacetedItem,
    useFaceted,
    useFacetedGroup,
} from './context';

/**
 * An option of the list: picking it selects it, or calls `@select` instead
 * when given. Hidden while it does not match the search.
 */
const props = defineProps<{
    value: string;
    /** Text the search matches; the label of the item in `items` by default. */
    label?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    class?: HTMLAttributes['class'];
    onSelect?: (value: string) => void;
}>();

const context = useFaceted('FacetedItem');
const visible = computed(() => context.matches(props.value, props.label));
const selected = computed(() =>
    getIsValueSelected(
        context.value.value,
        context.multiple.value,
        props.value,
    ),
);

registerFacetedItem(visible, context, useFacetedGroup());
provideFacetedItemSelected(selected);

function onSelect(event: Event) {
    // The list does not change its own value: the Faceted (or `@select`) does.
    event.preventDefault();

    if (props.onSelect) {
        props.onSelect(props.value);
        return;
    }

    context.selectItem(props.value);
}

function onPointerDown(event: PointerEvent) {
    // A focusable item would steal the focus of the search box.
    event.preventDefault();
    if (event.pointerType === 'touch') return;
    (event.currentTarget as HTMLElement)
        .closest('[data-slot=faceted-command]')
        ?.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('[data-slot=faceted-input]')
        ?.focus();
}
</script>

<template>
    <ListboxItem
        v-if="visible"
        data-slot="faceted-item"
        :value="value"
        :disabled="disabled"
        :data-checked="selected || undefined"
        :class="
            cn(
                'group/command-item relative flex cursor-default items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-1.5 py-1 text-sm outline-hidden select-none data-[disabled]:pointer-events-none data-[disabled]:opacity-50 data-[highlighted]:bg-accent data-[highlighted]:text-accent-foreground [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*=\'size-\'])]:size-4 data-[highlighted]:*:[svg]:text-accent-foreground',
                props.class,
            )
        "
        @select="onSelect"
        @pointerdown="onPointerDown"
        @mousedown.prevent
    >
        <slot :selected="selected" />
    </ListboxItem>
</template>
